label: agg-null-json-result-from
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d) IS NULL AS is_null FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS d)

label: agg-null-percentile-guard-from
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d) AS h FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS d)) SELECT IF(h IS NULL,NULL,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(h,99.0)) AS p99 FROM a

label: agg-bad-json-negative-from
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d) AS histogram FROM UNNEST(['not-json']) AS d
